title: FRENCH DRESSING
instructions: --For party of six five tablespoons of oil and three of vinegar,  juice of half lemon, two drops tobasco, tablespoon of salt, slice of onion, and boil for three minutes and ready for service. Strain and bottle and put in ice box, shake before using each time.
